salesLanguage.plainEnglishSummary: Use this when the source, display, USB device or control point is too far away for a simple local cable.

talkTrack: It solves a distance problem.
If USB is included, it can support cameras, touch displays, keyboards, mice or conferencing peripherals.
It is usually simpler than AV-over-IP when the path is one source to one display.

technicalLines: CE | FCC | RoHS | RCM | EAC | UKCA
featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The WyreStorm EX-60-USB2 is a plug-and-play USB 2.0 extender that transmits USB signals up to 60m (196ft) over a single Cat6/6a/7 cable utilizing a direct hardware-based transmission method, eliminating common USB compatibility issues. The EX-60-USB2 also supports one-way PoC (Power over Cable), allowing the transmitter to power the receiver through the same category cable—making installation simple and efficient. It’s an ideal solution for home offices, surveillance setups, and gaming environments, enabling you to extend USB devices such as cameras, speakerphones, and keyboards/mice from a local zone to a remote PC or laptop.

The EX-60-USB2 delivers high-speed data transfer rates of up to 480Mbps. The integrated USB hub allows direct connection of multiple peripherals, streamlining workstation setups and enhancing user convenience in diverse environments—from office workspaces to interactive kiosks.
With 4 USB device ports, it not only provides KVM functionality for extending keyboards, mice, or touchscreens, but also supports full USB data transfer for devices such as cameras and speakerphones.
With one-way PoC power support, simply power the transmitter and the receiver is powered through the category cable—reducing potential points of failure and simplifying installation.
Designed for true plug-and-play operation with zero configuration required, it provides hassle-free setup and immediate use right out of the box, making it exceptionally user-friendly.
